scripts.dev: pnpm build:sidecar && pnpm --dir apps/desktop tauri dev
scripts.build:windows: pnpm build:sidecar && pnpm --dir apps/desktop tauri build --bundles nsis
scripts.build:macos: pnpm build:sidecar && pnpm --dir apps/desktop tauri build --bundles dmg
scripts.artifacts: pnpm build:windows && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-portable.ps1 && pnpm sbom && node scripts/generate-hashes.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm check:contract && pnpm check:frontend && pnpm check:go && pnpm check:rust
scripts.check:go: node scripts/go.mjs -C services/workbenchd test ./... && node scripts/go.mjs -C services/workbenchd vet ./...
scripts.check:rust: pnpm build:sidecar && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.test: pnpm --dir apps/desktop test && node scripts/go.mjs -C services/workbenchd test ./... && cargo test --workspace
